code.title: Business entity code
code.description: The entity code of the business entity.

name.title: Name
name.description: This name describes your business entity and will appear on the invoice.

geo_code.description: Code that represents a geographic entity (location or object). Only returned when Vertex or Avalara for Communications is enabled.
Code that represents a geographic entity (location or object). Only returned when Vertex or Avalara for Communications is enabled.

origin_tax_address_source.title: Origin tax address source
origin_tax_address_source.description: The source of the address that will be used as the origin in determining taxes. Available only when the site is on an Elite plan. A value of "origin" refers to the "Business entity tax address". A value of "destination" refers to the "Customer tax address".

destination_tax_address_source.title: Destination tax address source
destination_tax_address_source.description: The source of the address that will be used as the destinaion in determining taxes. Available only when the site is on an Elite plan. A value of "destination" refers to the "Customer tax address". A value of "origin" refers to the "Business entity tax address".

default_vat_number.title: Default VAT number
default_vat_number.description: VAT number for the customer used on the invoice.

default_registration_number.title: Default registration number
default_registration_number.description: Registration number for the customer used on the invoice.

subscriber_location_countries.title: Subscriber location countries
subscriber_location_countries.description: List of countries for which the business entity will be used.

default_liability_gl_account_id.title: General Ledger Account ID
default_liability_gl_account_id.description:
The ID of a general ledger account. General ledger accounts are
only accessible as a part of the Recurly RevRec Standard and
Recurly RevRec Advanced features.

default_revenue_gl_account_id.title: General Ledger Account ID
default_revenue_gl_account_id.description:
The ID of a general ledger account. General ledger accounts are
only accessible as a part of the Recurly RevRec Standard and
Recurly RevRec Advanced features.
